unavailable_inputs: No German aFRR capacity-market clearing result file was present in the supplied directory.

notes: The panel contains national German aggregates, not VPP-metered data.
Auction clearing prices do not establish that a hypothetical VPP bid would have cleared or that the provider was prequalified.
The 15-minute panel is not yet a simulation result and does not validate any manuscript profit claim.
FCR product rows are retained by product; do not sum rows without modeling awarded MW and the applicable product settlement period.
